Text.Text: You've finished the Blood Frenzy trials and earned the right to train the technique. Keep practicing control after a kill; that lesson doesn't end with Kess.
Reach rank 50 in Vibroblade before you take these lessons. The Sewers Depths aren't a place to finish your basic training.

Blood Frenzy starts below Veles, in the Viscara Sewers Depths. Red Vein scavengers stole my codex and are treating its warnings as instructions. Defeat six Red Vein Scavengers to secure the Red Vein Codex, then return it to me here in the Veles Trade Concourse. I'll give you the Sewers Depths key when you accept. Complete all five lessons to earn the right to train Blood Frenzy.

Take the Viscara Sewers Depths Key. In the Veles Sewers, use 'Enter Sewers Depths'. Keep your party close when you enter so they can come with you. Defeat six Red Vein Scavengers, then bring the Red Vein Codex back to me in the Trade Concourse.
Defeat six Red Vein Scavengers in the Viscara Sewers Depths. Their defeat secures the Red Vein Codex; no separate search is needed. Bring it back to me in the Veles Trade Concourse.
The scavengers are defeated and you've recovered the Red Vein Codex. Let me see what they've done to it.
The codex is home before they could pass those mistakes on. Here's your hazard pay. Speak to me again for the timing lesson when you're ready.

Pulse-Frame Training Droids are hammering my old cadence into anyone who will listen in the Viscara Sewers Depths. Destroy five Pulse-Frame Training Droids to secure the Pulse Metronome, then return it to me in the Veles Trade Concourse. Kess's students don't need another lesson stripped of its restraint.

Your key still opens the Sewers Depths. Destroy five Pulse-Frame Training Droids and bring the Pulse Metronome back to me. Timing is the lesson; you don't need to perform a special sequence to recover the core.
Destroy five Pulse-Frame Training Droids in the Viscara Sewers Depths to secure the Pulse Metronome. Return it to me in the Veles Trade Concourse.
The five droids are destroyed. Hand me the Pulse Metronome; I want to check its timing.
It still keeps time. Good. Your pay is ready. Speak to me again when you're ready to deal with the Butcher.

The next lesson stinks of stim smoke. The Blood Frenzy Butcher has turned the technique into a chemical leash. In the Viscara Sewers Depths, use the '???' challenge marker to call him. Defeat him to secure the Adrenal Glass, then bring it to me in the Veles Trade Concourse. I'd bring two companions for this fight.

Accepting this lesson lets you call the Butcher through the '???' marker in the Sewers Depths. Gather your help before using it. Once he's defeated, bring the Adrenal Glass back to me; there's no separate lab search.

Use the '???' challenge marker in the Viscara Sewers Depths to call the Blood Frenzy Butcher. Defeat him and bring the Adrenal Glass to me in the Veles Trade Concourse. Two companions are recommended.
The Butcher is defeated. Hand me the Adrenal Glass; I can use it to bind a restraint charm.
This glass will take a binding. Take your hazard pay, then speak to me again about the duelists when you're ready.

Now we make restraint you can hold. Kess's duelists carry the pieces we need to finish the charm. Defeat four Blood Frenzy Duelists in the Viscara Sewers Depths to secure the Blood Frenzy Charm Fragments, then return them to me in the Veles Trade Concourse.
Defeat four Blood Frenzy Duelists in the Sewers Depths. Their defeat secures the charm fragments; you don't need to hunt for four separate drops. Bring the fragments back to me.
Defeat four Blood Frenzy Duelists in the Viscara Sewers Depths, then bring the Blood Frenzy Charm Fragments to me in the Veles Trade Concourse.
The four duelists are defeated and the charm fragments are recovered. Let's finish the binding.
The charm is complete. Your pay is ready. Speak to me again when you're prepared for the final lesson: Kess himself.

Kess Draavo calls himself the Blood Frenzy King. He's the source of the corrupted school. Go to the Cistern Ring beyond the Viscara Sewers Depths and use its '???' challenge marker to call him. Defeat Kess, then report to me in the Veles Trade Concourse. Bring two companions if you can. No item is needed for this final lesson.

The final lesson is accepted. Use the '???' challenge marker in the Cistern Ring to call Kess Draavo. Gather your party first. After he's defeated, come back to me in the Trade Concourse for the final lesson and payment.

Kess Draavo is still your target. Use the '???' challenge marker in the Cistern Ring beyond the Sewers Depths, defeat him, and report to me in the Veles Trade Concourse. Two companions are recommended.
Kess Draavo is defeated. Give me your report and we'll close the lesson.
The corrupted school is finished. You've earned the right to train Blood Frenzy, and your final payment is ready. Keep control of the surge after victory; that's what Kess forgot.
Sera taps two fingers to her wrist. 'The body celebrates before the mind catches up. Blood Frenzy teaches you to spend that surge, not become it. Victory gives heat; discipline gives it a shape.'
'Red Vein' was a name thieves used when they wanted murder to sound like scholarship. They stole an old copy, stripped out every warning, and left scavengers under Veles to read the leftovers aloud.

Take the key when you accept. In the Veles Sewers, use the marker named 'Enter Sewers Depths'. It opens for the key holder. Keep your party close to the marker when you use it so they can enter with you.
'Because rage lies about time. It says now, now, now. The thirteenth beat teaches waiting while your nerves burn. The Pulse-Frames punish anyone who swings early.'
'A timing core, old Republic training stock before Veles learned to hide its better mistakes. Do not crack it open. If it still clicks when you hand it to me, it can teach you more than any corpse.'
'He turned the after-kill rush into a chemical leash. A stim tap in the arm, an audience stupid enough to clap, and suddenly discipline becomes a show with a body count.'
'Blood, stim resin, adrenal salts, heat. It hardens in the lab equipment when the mixture is abused. Ugly, useful. I can make it say stop when your pulse says again.'
'Because sometimes the hand needs an object before it believes an order. Not forever. Just long enough to remember the blade belongs to you, not the moment after the kill.'
'Kess has them performing around fragments like relics. Every duelist thinks the next kill proves devotion. Take the fragments before devotion becomes recruitment.'
'Clever enough to learn the lesson, vain enough to rename the wound. He calls himself king because teacher would make him answer for what he made.'

Then I finish your training qualification. The refusal is the lesson: a victory gives you a surge, and you decide how to use it. Completing the trials earns you the right to train Blood Frenzy; it doesn't replace practice.
'Count the breath after a kill. If you need another target before that breath is done, you are not using Blood Frenzy. It is using you.'
I'm listening. Give me the first cut.
I recovered the Red Vein Codex.
The codex is still below Veles.
The codex is yours. The warnings are still in it.
I will break their rhythm.
I brought the pulse metron.
The droids are still keeping time.
The metronome core still ticks.
The Butcher falls.
I have the adrenal glass.
The lab is not finished.
The Butcher is dead. I brought the glass.
I will take the fragments.
I recovered the charm fragments.
The duelists still hold the fragments.
I have the charm fragments.
I will end his circle.
Kess is still breathing.
Kess is dead. His circle is quiet.
Not now.
What is Blood Frenzy, really?
Why is the Red Vein Codex in the Sewers Depths?
How do I reach the Sewers Depths?
Why the thirteen beats?
What is the pulse metronome?
What did the Butcher do to the lesson?
What is adrenal glass?
Why make a restraint charm?
What are Kess's duelists doing?
Who is Kess Draavo?
What happens after he dies?
What should I keep practicing?
